description: Proposals for the ai_generated sources of the surnames-17 batch. Not yet decided; the operator decides each one. PAT_CHAABANE has no candidate: no real work stating the claim was found.

verifications.claim: id: PAT_CARVALHO; nameMain: Carvalho; nameSystem: hereditary_family_name; transmissionMode: other; designatedSocialUnit: other

candidates.title: Dictionary of American Family Names, 2e éd. — Carvalho
candidates.author: Patrick Hanks (dir.)
candidates.quote: Portuguese : topographic name for someone who lived by a conspicuous oak tree carvalho or a habitational name from any of numerous places called with this word.
candidates.supports: Carvalho is a Portuguese family name from carvalho 'oak'. Supports the name's form and meaning, not its presence in Sao Tome and Principe.

id: PAT_CHERIF; nameMain: Cherif; nameSystem: nisba; transmissionMode: other; designatedSocialUnit: other

candidates.title: Étude anthroponymique de la commune d'Aokas de 1962 à 1970
candidates.author: Lynda Salhi
candidates.quote: Cherif, Cherifa : de la racine arabe [ČRF], dérivé de « Charif » qui signifie « noble »
candidates.supports: Cherif is attested as a masculine first name at Aokas (Algeria) and derived from Arabic sharif 'noble'. Page 50, read in full on 14 October 2026.

verifications.claim: id: PAT_CHIRINDZA; nameMain: Chirindza; nameSystem: clan_name; transmissionMode: other; designatedSocialUnit: clan

candidates.title: East and Northeast of the Borders of the Southeastern Bantu: Partly visible population movements and invisible lineage states
candidates.author: Gerhard Liesegang
candidates.quote: The presence of clan names from the south like Chirindza (from Manhica in the South), Gwambe (from Inharrime) among the Vilankulu [...]
candidates.supports: Chirindza is a clan name in southern Mozambique, said to come from Manhica. Unofficial manuscript copy on archive.org, page 41.

verifications.claim: id: PAT_CHIRWA; nameMain: Chirwa; nameSystem: clan_name; transmissionMode: other; designatedSocialUnit: lineage

candidates.title: Chirwa, Yuraia Chatonda — Dictionary of African Christian Biography
candidates.author: Masauko Wellby Tembo
candidates.supports: Chirwa is a surname borne in Malawi, here by a Tonga man (c. 1865-1951). Supports the country and a bearer, not a clan structure.

verifications.claim: id: PAT_CHISSANO; nameMain: Chissano; nameSystem: clan_name; transmissionMode: other; designatedSocialUnit: lineage

candidates.title: Diário de Lisboa 1974-09-20: ano 54, n.º 18567
candidates.author: Diário de Lisboa
candidates.supports: Chissano is a family name written in Mozambique in 1974 (prime minister of the transitional government). Supports attestation only; the page says nothing about clan structure.

candidates.quote: Messrs Pena and Chitunda, both senior UNITA commanders, were killed on 1 November 1992,
